hero.title: Auto Allocation Guide
hero.lead: How the system decides, line item by line item, _what ships from stock and what gets dropshipped_ when you book a pending order, including partial stock, backorders, warehouse priority, and pulling inventory from a parent.
hero.pill: Intended behavior reference · Standard & Store orders

start.heading: How auto-allocation works, in one minute
start.lead: When you **book** a pending order, auto-allocation walks every line item, and every size within it, and asks one question: **can I cover this from stock?** Then it reserves what it can and routes the rest.
start.info: **Three outcomes per size, decided by available stock:** 1) **Enough stock**, the row stays Stock and inventory is reserved. 2) **Partial stock**, the covered quantity stays Stock and the shortfall becomes a DropShip line (or a Backorder, if that mode is on). 3) **No stock**, DropShip / Backorder / in-place flip depending on settings.
start.body: The line-item "source from stock vs dropship" value is the **Matrix PO type**, shown as **Source** on the order line. On the product itself, the eligibility field is **Li Type**.

prereq.heading: Prerequisites, when auto-allocation runs
prereq.lead: All of these must be true, or the order books without any auto-allocation happening.

prereq.note: **Aether Store Orders** have a special path: a zero-stock line is sent to backorder even when the system-level auto-allocation setting is OFF (scenarios SC-10 and SC-11).

outcomes.heading: The allocation outcomes
outcomes.lead: For each size, allocated = min(required, available stock) and remainder = required minus allocated. What happens to the remainder is the whole story.

cards.title: All Stock
cards.body: Stock covers the row. It stays Stock and inventory is reserved. No DropShip line.

cards.title: Stock + DropShip line
cards.body: The covered quantity stays Stock; the shortfall (plus any fully-unstocked sizes) moves to a new DropShip line.

cards.title: Stock + Backorder
cards.body: With Backorder mode on, nothing splits off. The line stays a single Stock line and the shortfall is stored as a backorder (bell).

outcomes.note: **When no size has any stock** the entire original line flips to DropShip in-place (no separate line). With a Default warehouse and Backorder mode, the full quantity is backordered against the Default warehouse instead.

warehouse.heading: Warehouse priority & fallback
warehouse.lead: Available stock depends on which warehouse the system checks. It walks a priority list and stops at the first that can cover the row.

table.notes: Customer override if set, otherwise global.
Only if Search Warehouses for Stock is ON.
Final fallback. If empty too, the row follows DropShip / Backorder rules.

warehouse.info: **Customer override wins:** if a customer has its own priority set, the global list is not consulted (scenario SC-9).

parent.heading: Parent to Child inventory transfer
parent.lead: With Share Parent Inventory on, a child that is short on stock can pull inventory from its parent at booking, before the shortfall is dropshipped or backordered.

table.behavior: If the line's Matrix PO type is DropShip, no transfer happens.
min(shortfall, parent inventory). If the parent can't cover it all, the rest is backordered/dropshipped.
Normally only works when parent and child stock are the same warehouse type (Customer-owned, Distributor-owned, Vendor-owned).
If the child has 0 stock for the items, it can pull from the parent regardless of warehouse type.
If you unreserve the line after booking, the child keeps the transferred inventory.

parent.info: **Two switches enable this:** the product opt-in Share Parent Inventory (Product, Child Product Settings) and the system-level Allow Transfer Parent Inventory to Child Pre-Decorated Products (Admin, Settings, Orders). Per that setting's label, the transfer is scoped to Aether orders and pre-decorated child products.
